topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: The city's got its way of telling you when things are gonna change, and it's not always in the whisper of the wind or the chatter of the streets.Sometimes, it's in the quiet note on the door of a place you thought was as steady as a heartbeat. Like this morning, I stepped up to the place where the usual suspects gathered, the walls lined with memories and the smell of the old days. There on the glass, a piece of paper, a few words that felt like a punch to the gut. "Closing." The place where the regulars nodded and the coffee was just right. I stood there, the rain starting to mist around me, thinking about how the city swallows up its own, even the spots you'd swear were too good to lose. Just another casualty, I reckon, but it made me pause.
